_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for business facts. Templates, JSON-LD, the sitemap and llms.txt all read from here, so NAP consistency is structural rather than manually maintained. Anything with a `null` is an open question for Wesleigh (see the plan checklist). Do not invent values: a null renders nothing, a wrong value publishes a false claim and contradicts the Google Business Profile.
name: Collaborative Construction, LLC
description: Residential construction and renovation built on a professional, client-centered approach, serving Cape Cod and the Islands and the South Shore of Massachusetts.
footerBlurb: Residential construction & renovation built on a professional, client-centered approach. Proudly serving Cape Cod & the Islands and the South Shore.
_addressComment: Must match the Google Business Profile character for character. Google cross-references the two and inconsistent NAP is a known local-ranking drag. This is Wesleigh's home address and he confirmed publishing it; it is already public on the GBP. If that ever changes, switch the GBP to a service-area business FIRST, then shorten `display` and null out `street` here.

address.display: 16 Terry Lou Ave, East Falmouth, MA 02536

_serviceAreaComment: Wesleigh has not yet resolved the service-area question. 4 of 7 portfolio projects (Belmont, Newton, Carlisle, Dudley) sit outside the areas claimed below. See docs and the plan checklist. Changing this array changes the areaServed schema, the footer, and the location pages together.
_areaServedDisplay: Prose form for llms.txt and page copy. areaServed below is the discrete list schema.org needs as AdministrativeArea nodes; keep the two in agreement.

_hoursComment: Confirmed directly by the owner: 7 AM to 4 PM Monday through Saturday, closed Sunday. NOTE: the Google Business Profile currently still says Saturday 7 AM-12 PM. Until that is corrected in the GBP, the site and Google disagree about Saturday, which is exactly the NAP inconsistency this file exists to prevent. Fix the GBP, do not change this back.
